configs.description: NOC view of Keysight IxFlow data: KPIs, traffic and latency trends, distribution pies.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Total Bytes

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes) unwind=true | limit 1000 | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb)

configs.description: Client + server bytes of all IxFlow flows.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Flows

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixFlows=sum(flows) unwind=true | limit 1000

configs.description: Number of IxFlow flows.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Applications

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcIxApplication=dc(ixApplication) unwind=true | limit 1000

configs.description: Distinct applications classified by IxFlow.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Clients

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcClientIp=dc(clientIp) unwind=true | limit 1000

configs.description: Distinct client IP addresses.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Servers

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcServerIp=dc(serverIp) unwind=true | limit 1000

configs.description: Distinct server IP addresses.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Avg TCP App Response

queries.nql: ixTcpAppResponseTime > 0 | aggr ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw=avg(ixTcpAppResponseTime) unwind=true | limit 1000 | set ixAvgTcpAppResponseTime=div(ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw,1000)

configs.description: Average TCP application response time (3054:281), milliseconds. Orange > 20 ms, red > 50 ms.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Avg Transaction Latency

queries.nql: ixTransactionLatency > 0 | aggr ixAvgTransactionLatencyRaw=avg(ixTransactionLatency) unwind=true | limit 1000 | set ixAvgTransactionLatency=div(ixAvgTransactionLatencyRaw,1000)

configs.description: Average latency of the first transaction in a flow (3054:188), milliseconds. Orange > 20 ms, red > 50 ms.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Unclassified Bytes

queries.nql: ixApplication = "unknown" | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes) unwind=true | limit 1000 | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb)

configs.description: Bytes of flows with application "unknown".

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Traffic Volume

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | timeAggr ixClientBytes=sum(clientBytes), ixServerBytes=sum(serverBytes) on timestamp interval="${AUTOBUCKET_INTERVAL}" dir="desc" unwind=true bucketAlias="srcEventTimestamp" | limit 500

configs.description: Client and server bytes of all IxFlow flows over time.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Latency

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: (ixTcpAppResponseTime > 0 OR ixTransactionLatency > 0) | timeAggr ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw=avg(ixTcpAppResponseTime), ixAvgTransactionLatencyRaw=avg(ixTransactionLatency) on timestamp interval="${AUTOBUCKET_INTERVAL}" dir="desc" unwind=true bucketAlias="srcEventTimestamp" | set ixAvgTcpAppResponseTime=div(ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw,1000), ixAvgTransactionLatency=div(ixAvgTransactionLatencyRaw,1000) | limit 500

configs.description: Average TCP application response time and transaction latency (ms) over time.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Applications by Bytes

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes) by ixApplication as ixApplication unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | fork (sort ixBytes desc | limit 8), (sort ixBytes desc | limit 8, ALL | aggr ixBytes=sum(ixBytes), total=count(1) | set ixApplication="Others", _isOtherRow=true)

configs.description: Share of bytes per application (top 8 + Others).

configs.description: Share of flows per application (top 8 + Others).

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Slowest Applications

queries.nql: ixTcpAppResponseTime > 0 | aggr ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw=avg(ixTcpAppResponseTime), ixMaxTcpAppResponseTimeRaw=max(ixTcpAppResponseTime), ixFlows=sum(flows), ixDcClientIp=dc(clientIp) by ixApplication as ixApplication unwind=true | set ixAvgTcpAppResponseTime=div(ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw,1000), ixMaxTcpAppResponseTime=div(ixMaxTcpAppResponseTimeRaw,1000) | sort ixAvgTcpAppResponseTime desc | limit 50

configs.description: Applications ranked by average TCP application response time.

configs.name: IxFlow | NOC Top Talkers

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes), ixFlows=sum(flows), ixDcIxApplication=dc(ixApplication) by clientIp as clientIp, ixClientIpCountryName as ixClientIpCountryName unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 50

configs.description: Client IP addresses with the highest volume.
